name: Arcane Disposition: draw 2 (3 with Class Bonus), discard hand at next end phase
notes: Arcane Disposition is ARCANE, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ARCANE champion (Lorraine, Arclight Saber) to unlock element access -- this grants a lineage-inherited 'Enlighten' fast-action opportunity once reserve is paid (same side effect as arcane-sight-level-draw); both players decline. Draws 2 (the [Class Bonus] 3rd draw is out of scope), then sets a delayed-discard flag (blq7qXGvWH_DISCARD_NEXT_END, GameLogic.php ~10454-10463) that fires at the next end phase -- directly observable via card_exists in myGlobalEffects without needing to reach that end phase.

rulesClauses: At the beginning of the next end phase, discard your hand.
